title: Corona problem for the unit polydisc
exact_target: Can bounded holomorphic functions on every higher-dimensional polydisc that stay uniformly away from a common zero always solve a bounded holomorphic B\'ezout equation?

sources.citation: Alexander Brudnyi and Mahishanka Withanachchi, Solvability of the Bézout Equation for Banach Algebra–valued H-infinity Functions on the Polydisk, arXiv2512.23733v2 (3Jan2026).
